name: aozaki
description: A modern Komari theme built with Astro, React, TailwindCSS and shadcn/ui

scripts.check: rm -rf dist .astro node_modules/.cache theme-package aozaki-v*.zip komari-theme-v*.zip && astro check
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun run format:check
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist .astro node_modules/.cache theme-package aozaki-v*.zip komari-theme-v*.zip
scripts.clean:all: rm -rf dist .astro node_modules/.cache theme-package node_modules bun.lock aozaki-v*.zip komari-theme-v*.zip
